title: Preserve independent rail widths and give Today’s Goals a rail-integrated treatment

source.ref: Owner desktop rail and goals screenshot 2026-10-15

detail: The stored-preference decoder overwrote the saved right width with the left width on each load, defeating existing asymmetric248/288 CSS defaults. Decode each side independently, migrate legacy shared width to the left while leaving right on its wider default, and retain collapse states, leave absent widths null so server and fresh hydration use the same CSS defaults. Goals now uses a dedicated full-width transparent section with18px display heading, wrapping header, taller goal links and6px progress bars; other rail cards retain their chrome. Saved equal widths remain an explicit prior preference. No production writes. Focused persistence tests and lint pass; rendered integrated desktop/mobile verification pending.

verify.evidence: 4 consequence tests pass in lib/layout/rail-preferences.test.ts: fresh/malformed storage keeps CSS auto defaults; independent230/310 survives reload; left-only resize leaves right auto; v1 width migrates without forcing equal rails and corrupt bounds handled. Final integrated browser checks needed: fresh desktop248/288 before/after hydration, independently resized reload, Goals width/hierarchy,320/390 inline/mobile no overflow.
